```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

This is the line where I put my maths equation, $x = 1+y$
The next thing is going to be display mode math

$$x = \sum_{n=0}^{10} \sqrt{ \frac{(1+y)^2}{n}} $$

```{r}
prob1 = tibble(
  x = 0:4,
  p = c(0.15, 0.25, 0.05, 0.35, NA)
)

prob1
```

```{r}
prob1[5,2] <- 0.2
prob1
```

## Expectation and variance

```{r}
prob1 %>% mutate("x.P(x)" = x*p, "(x-E)2.P(x)" = (x-sum(`x.P(x)`))^2*p) %>% summarize(E = sum(`x.P(x)`), Var = sum(`(x-E)2.P(x)`))
```

```{r}
ggplot(prob1, aes(x = x, y = p)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = x, yend = 0), color = "blue", size=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  ylab("P(X=x)") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of X")
```
